top_signals.title: Yen May Climb Back Toward Upper 150s Per Dollar, Barclays Says
top_signals.summary: The yen’s sharp rally could reverse toward the upper 150s per dollar if expectations for faster Bank of Japan rate hikes and a shift by Japanese pension funds toward domestic assets fail to materialize, according to Barclays Plc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Aster Eyes Latin America, Africa as Mideast Flows Fall
top_signals.summary: Singapore refiner Aster Chemicals and Energy Pte is buying crude from as far afield as Latin America and West Africa to replace Middle Eastern supplies squeezed by the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: SkyAI’s proposed equity plan would authorize 5.145 million shares for stock-based compensation, representing roughly 7.2% additional dilution.

top_signals.title: Can India's Modern Buildings Find Their Own Identity?
top_signals.summary:
India is in the midst of a massive construction boom, but what makes its modern architecture distinctly Indian? Menaka Doshi explores buildings designed around the country’s climate, culture and people, rather than simply borrowing from the West.

Photo Credit: Vinay Panjwani/Sanjay Puri Architects (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
top_signals.summary: A 26-year-old Canadian man once described as one of the most consequential cybercrime threat actors of 2024 has pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy to hack and extort more than 165 organizations that used the cloud data storage provider Snowflake. Connor Riley Moucka, of Kitchener, Ontario, also admitted to stealing call and text history records of more than 100 million AT&T customers.
